questions.context_sentence: Sarah and I have decided to have a party.
questions.cn: 莎我和决定开个派对。
questions.hint: de (向下) + cide (切) -> 下定决心，把事情“切”准
questions.prompt: Sarah and I have ____ to have a party. (提示: 决定)

questions.context_sentence: We use will to announce a new decision.
questions.cn: 我们用will来宣布一个新的决定。
questions.hint: an (向) + nounce (讲话) -> 大声向大家讲话 -> 宣布

questions.context_sentence: I think the weather will be nice later.
questions.cn: 我认为待会儿天气会很好。
questions.hint: we (我们) + ather (听起来像啊瑟) -> 我们都在谈论今天的天气

questions.context_sentence: We use both will and going to for predicting the future.
questions.cn: 我们用will和going to来预测未来。
questions.hint: pre (提前) + dict (说) -> 提前说出未来的事 -> 预测
questions.prompt: We use both will and going to for ____ the future. (提示: 预测，预言)

questions.context_sentence: Look at those black clouds.
questions.cn: 看那些黑云。
questions.hint: cl (开头) + oud (大声) -> 天空中的黑云大声打雷

questions.context_sentence: I forgot my wallet.
questions.cn: 我忘记带钱包了。
questions.hint: wal (挖) + let (让) -> 挖钱让进钱包里

questions.context_sentence: Why are you filling that bucket with water?
questions.cn: 你为什么要把那个水桶装满水？
questions.hint: buck (雄鹿) + et (小后缀) -> 小雄鹿用桶提水
questions.prompt: Why are you filling that ____ with water? (提示: 水桶)

questions.context_sentence: That ceiling looks dangerous.
questions.cn: 那个天花板看起来很危险。
questions.hint: ceil (像seal海豹) + ing -> 海豹顶着天花板

questions.context_sentence: They are building a new skyscraper here.
questions.cn: 他们在这里建造一座新的摩天大楼。
questions.hint: sky (天空) + scraper (刮擦者) -> 刮到天空的大楼 -> 摩天大楼

questions.context_sentence: Jack is very determined.
questions.cn: 杰克非常坚定。
questions.hint: de + term (期限) + ined -> 下定决心在期限内完成 -> 坚定的
questions.prompt: Jack is very ____. (提示: 坚定的，坚决的)
